title: NEW INFO Dev-h tdd calculation doesnt work in stats tab
body:
Tdd calculation doesnt work anymore.

Maybe related. Also notice really slow refresh of main screen calculations. (takes regularly 15 Till 30 secs to calculate all graphs).

Tried reset button from stats, didnt work.
Tried cleaning database (deleted all old data) from maintenance, didnt work.

Already noticed that tdd calculation was slow sometimes, the last months, but they eventually did come through. Now they dont appear anymore.

Am using dana-i. Issue has nothing to do with the tdd stats directly from dana. That works fine still.

[Screenshot_20230219-231241](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15680598/219978741-5dd2d1f8-e891-4784-bb03-0057b795ba2b.png)
